mapper.sql: id, project_id, name, version, purpose, storage_ref, content_type, size_bytes, sha256, status, uploaded_by, created_at
mapper.select: select from customer_document where id = #{id} for update
select version from customer_document where project_id=#{projectId} order by version desc limit 1 for update
select from customer_document where project_id = #{projectId} order by created_at desc
mapper.insert: insert into customer_document (id, project_id, name, version, purpose, storage_ref, content_type, size_bytes, sha256, status, uploaded_by, created_at) values (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{name}, #{version}, #{purpose}, #{storageRef}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{sha256}, #{status}, #{uploadedBy}, #{createdAt})
